test_set_change: No test-set change this snapshot. mini-231 continues from 2026-09, held bit-for-bit. The Sub-Saharan African bucket promised as the second half of the Q3 expansion remains below N=12 and is NOT included. Because the set is unchanged, the two deterministic open-source baselines return bit-identical to 2026-09 (10.4% and 11.5%). Their stability remains the control confirming app-side drift.

tiers.photo: Photo-based systems evaluated end-to-end on food images.
tiers.manual: Manual-entry apps whose primary input is text search or barcode.
